assessments.reasoning: Section 14.3.1.1 attaches a Syntax Error to an absent initializer on the plain-identifier lexical binding when its declaration is constant. The decision in §8.2.3 is true for const and false for let. Section 14.7.5 uses ForDeclaration and ForBinding for the loop-header exception.

challenge.method: Trace the lexical-binding production and IsConstantDeclaration. Check an ordinary declaration, classic for, for-in and for-of against the distinct grammar and run small parser examples.
challenge.results: The early-error rule reaches the ordinary declaration and the classic for header. The for-in and for-of grammar leaves the value supply to loop evaluation. The local Node.js v24.4.1 diagnostic agreed. Bare and classic-for declaration rejected; for-of and for-in accepted.

limitations: The rule governs parse-time binding syntax. The mutability of an object later referred to by a const is outside its effect.
